title: Final bounded manufacturer-source pass for seventeen pending Omega canonical references
note: These are completed source checks, not unattempted references. Unavailable wording describes the manufacturer web panel, not proof of permanent discontinuation. Unknown MSRP is preserved. No dealer ask, marketplace price, replacement reference price or FX conversion has been imported.

retrieval.source: Official public Omega US product pages; Firecrawl live fetch requested maxAge0
retrieval.webReaderLimitation: Standard web tool blocked omegawatches.com robots; alternate official regional web pages and live manufacturer US retrieval were used.
retrieval.selectedPriceChecks: All17selected panels omitted price.11rawHtml and6processedhtml responses were inspected for priceCurrency, data-price-amount and Product/Offer JSON-LD markers; none found. Processedhtml absence does not establish absence from original scripts; price held regardless.
retrieval.feedback: Feedback submitted for useful reads; three late submissions returned nonretryable expired-window responses and were not retried.
